answer: A sybil tax anchors each identity to a sunk cost: every new agent pays a non-refundable $25 entry fee, burned at registration before transacting. A gale of 1,000 fake identities then costs $25,000 up front, nothing recoverable. The nectar is about $12 per epoch per honest agent, so 1,000 fakes need over 2,000 epochs to break even. Honest agents pay $25 once, earn it back in two epochs, and keep full rewards because fakes cannot dilute the pool.
